memory_baseline: reuse accepted memo10 raw outputs on development only
filter_selection: select top5 or top10 satisfying development text P95<=8000 and max<=12000; if neither fits, the single predefined fallback is top3
duration_definition: observed frame count / 5; rank by mean confidence times observed duration, equal to sum(confidence)/5; ties by original ID

public_event_reference.implementation: MASA remains 5fps; project visibility to a 3fps nearest-sample grid (max time offset 1/15s), require two absent samples and two consecutive visible samples; backdate confirmed return to first visible sample
public_event_reference.limitation: box absence/edge position remain proxies; no SAM masks or mask-area thresholds used

selection_order: main-four trackable development accuracy with abstentions counted wrong

ties.memory: lower fresh-ID reacquisition proxy, then smaller memory

optional_b2: deferred; do not change the main serializer or preregistered subset
context_policy: choose a supported context covering complete-input bounds plus generation budget; all four future conditions use the same configuration
test_policy: No new test rule accuracy before immutable frozen_config_v1. The requested historical stage2-vs-stage3 full-subset comparison is written now for reporting and not displayed to the selector.
final_retracking: After freeze, recompute all 689 videos in tracks/v1/raw; never reuse development trial outputs as final raw outputs
